title: Release day leaves every role's permissions as they were
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role from before this release, role A, with View and Create & Edit ticked and Delete unticked in the parts inventory group.
  • Have a screenshot of role A's permissions taken before this release, so they can be compared.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in as user B, who has had role A since before this release.
  • Start on Roles & Permissions (Settings, then Roles & Permissions).
custom_steps:
1. Click the edit (pencil) button of role A.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. In browser 2, as user B, click Parts in the top bar.
  4. In browser 2, click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. In browser 2, click any part row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Exactly the same permissions are ticked as in the screenshot: under the renamed group "Part Library and Inventory", View and Create & Edit are ticked and Delete is not.
  • No permission was added, removed or moved.

Step 2:

  • The page closes without saving.

Step 3:

  • User B's Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • User B can open the Inventory list, as on the day before the release.

Step 5:

  • The part window opens for user B without a Delete Part button, because role A still has no Delete.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”
  • S12-R6: “On Settings → Roles & Permissions → Edit Role, the permission group is titled "Part Library and Inventory".”
  • S8-R12: “Delete Part in the part dialog requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission. Without it the button is not shown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
